category_title: Third-grade African American students who rely on picture support and skip text when overwhelmed
scenario_title: Oral reading with high word density and picture reliance
minimal_context: Tommy is reading a text with high word density and illustrations aloud during a tutoring session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please read this page out loud for me.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the page) That's a lot of words. I'm just going to skip down to this line here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, go ahead and read that part.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Pulled on his, pulled on his shirt and put.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Look at the words again. Are you sure it says shirt?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Points confidently to the illustration on the page) Yeah, shirt. You see his shirt?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please read this page out loud for me.

STUDENT: (Looks at the page) That's a lot of words. I'm just going to skip down to this line here.

TUTOR: Okay, go ahead and read that part.

STUDENT: Pulled on his, pulled on his shirt and put.

TUTOR: Look at the words again. Are you sure it says shirt?

STUDENT: (Points confidently to the illustration on the page) Yeah, shirt. You see his shirt?

task.content: Oral reading of a text containing the sentence 'Pulled on his sneakers-zup!'
task.learning_goal: To monitor reading and understand the text by self-correcting low-quality miscues that change the meaning.

context.materials: Text with pictures and a high number of words on a page, audio recording device
context.social_setting: One-on-one or small group with a teacher

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When encountering the word 'sneakers' while relying on picture clues
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Read 'Pulled on his sneakers-zup!' as 'Put on his shirt-zot!' and explained the miscue by pointing to the picture clues.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Believed he was a good reader and was already employing effective reading strategies
related_quotes: Pulled on his, pulled on his shirt and put.
Yeah, shirt . You see his shirt ?

behavior_patterns.condition: When overwhelmed with the number of words on a page
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Began with skipping words, lines, and phrases; relied heavily on picture support.
